message.content:
**Pantone Sky Blue**

| Pantone Code | Description | Hex Code |
|--------------|-------------|----------|
| **Pantone 290 C** | Light sky blue (coated paper) | #D0E7FF |
| **Pantone 290 U** | Light sky blue (uncoated paper) | #D0E7FF |
| **Pantone 2905 C** | Slightly deeper sky blue (coated paper) | #B8D9FF |
| **Pantone 2905 U** | Slightly deeper sky blue (uncoated paper) | #B8D9FF |

> *Note:* Pantone 290 C and 290 U are the most commonly referenced “sky blue” shades. If you need a slightly richer tone, try 2905 C or 2905 U. The hex codes above are approximate digital equivalents for web or screen use.
